fixed_decision_order: Any binding, source, isolation, parent-reproduction, call-ledger, finite, completeness, solver-breakdown, camera-permutation, input-tree, or independent-comparison failure makes v196 inconclusive.
If Zero-CGLS K4 fails any strict cell or complete calibration-sensor tail, conclude INCONCLUSIVE_REFERENCE_ZERO_K4_INADEQUATE_V196; no primary claim is allowed.
If full_dct_k2 fails any strict cell or complete calibration-sensor tail, conclude FAIL_FULL_DCT_K2_COMPLETE_TRAJECTORY_V196 and close the dense full-DCT K2 reference on this opened trajectory.
If full_dct_k2 passes and zero_cgls_k2 also passes, conclude PASS_ZERO_K2_CHEAPER_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_V196 and do not advance the full-DCT initializer.

If full_dct_k2 passes, zero_cgls_k2 fails, and zero_cgls_k3 passes, conclude PASS_ZERO_K3_NEAR_COST_CONTROL_BLOCKS_DENSE_REFERENCE_V196; the one-adjoint difference does not authorize a predictor without a separately frozen complete classical-control and resource gate.

Only if full_dct_k2 passes all 2626 cells and 26 complete groups while Zero-CGLS K2 and K3 fail and Zero-CGLS K4 passes may v196 conclude PASS_FULL_DCT_K2_DENSE_REFERENCE_HEADROOM_V196 and authorize one separately frozen classical-control gate before any compact predictor.
